summary: Implemented the feature without running any code, tests, or installs. Nothing is committed. Changes: new monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver with save, save_batch, finalize, overwrite merge rules) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver with save, save_batch, private static _create_file_basename, dtype falls back to data dtype). monai/data/nifti_writer.py default dtype is now np.float32. monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py gained plot_2d_or_3d_image beside the unchanged GIF helpers. monai/handlers/segmentation_saver.py, classification_saver.py, and tensorboard_handlers.py are thin adapters over the savers and plot function; the classification handler registers an engine-accepting wrapper on completion; TensorBoardImageHandler gained index before max_channels. output_path renamed to output_dir in tests/integration_sliding_window.py, examples/segmentation_3d/unet_evaluation_array.py, and unet_evaluation_dict.py. Tests: new tests/test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py; tests/test_handler_classification_saver.py now passes filename. Static checks only: no lines over 120 characters, no trailing whitespace, single final newline in each changed file. flake8 and pytest have NOT been run, so test and lint results are unverified. Choices made: CSV keys coerced to str; NIfTI saver converts tensor affines to numpy; segmentation handler stores its saver as self.saver; TensorBoard handler calls batch transform once; no TensorBoard test added for the new index argument.
